scope: All original low46 physical Green kernels on the same fixed old metric: 25 target blocks, 25 source blocks, powers 2/1/0, signed physical modes 2 through92, P/K, sigma0 and original common sigma; not a nonlinear feedback or closed-surface theorem.

producer_resource.scope:
Run one owned numerical command and record wait4 resource/exit status.

This is a small replacement for /usr/bin/time, absent in this environment.
Usage: strong_resource_run.py --out resource.json -- python ...
The child inherits ordinary stdin/stdout/stderr; no solver behavior changes.
